name: djinn-codex
description: Codex adapter for the djinn code review relay. Built from plugins/djinn in the djinn-relay repo, which stays the only edited source. Slice 1 of the adapter: djinn-status only.

defaultPrompt: Use $djinn-status to show what is still open in the latest audit
